title: Operation Epic Fury - US & Israel Strike Iran, Khamenei Killed
description: US and Israel launched coordinated airstrikes on Iran under Operation Epic Fury. Targets included military facilities, nuclear sites, and leadership. Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei killed. Iran responded with missile barrages on Israeli cities and US bases in UAE, Qatar, and Bahrain. Hezbollah launched rockets into Israel from Lebanon. Strait of Hormuz effectively closed. Over 200 IRGC personnel killed, 50+ civilian casualties.

title: Iranian Missile Barrages Hit Israeli Cities - Retaliation for Epic Fury
description: Iran responded to Operation Epic Fury with missile barrages on Israeli cities. Multiple impacts reported. Iron Dome interceptors activated across central and northern Israel.

title: IRGC Attacks Multiple Tankers - Skylight & MKD Vyom Abandoned
description: IRGC attacked multiple vessels on March 1. Tanker Skylight (Palau-flagged) abandoned - 2 crew killed including captain. Tanker MKD Vyom (Marshall Islands) abandoned - 1 crew killed. Hercules Star (Gibraltar) and Ocean Electra (Liberia) sustained minor damage. LCT Ayeh (UAE) damaged.

title: More Tankers Hit - Stena Imperative, Athe Nova, Gold Oak Damaged
description: IRGC continued attacks on commercial shipping. Stena Imperative (US-flagged products tanker), Athe Nova (Honduras bitumen tanker), and Gold Oak (Panama bulk carrier) all damaged. Tanker traffic through strait dropped near zero.

title: Hezbollah Opens Northern Front - Rockets at Haifa, 52 Killed in Israeli Retaliation
description: Hezbollah fired projectiles toward Israel from Lebanon in response to Khamenei killing. Targeted Mishmar HaCarmel missile defence site near Haifa. Israeli retaliatory strikes killed at least 52 and injured 154. Hezbollah intelligence chief Hussain Makled killed. Lebanon banned Hezbollah military activities.

title: IDF Strikes Beirut - Hezbollah Hits Ramat David Airbase with Drones
location: Beirut, Lebanon / Ramat David Airbase, Israel
description: IDF carried out airstrikes on Beirut and deployed soldiers to southern Lebanon. Hezbollah conducted drone and missile attacks on Ramat David Airbase, Meron monitoring base, and Camp Yitzhak. Israeli ground forces entered southern Lebanon.

title: Hezbollah Drones & Missiles Strike Ramat David Airbase, Meron Base & Camp Yitzhak
location: Ramat David Airbase / Meron / Camp Yitzhak, Northern Israel
description: Hezbollah conducted drone and missile attacks on Ramat David Airbase, the Meron monitoring base, and Camp Yitzhak inside Israeli territory. IDF carried out simultaneous airstrikes on Beirut.

title: Iran Formally Declares Strait of Hormuz Closed
description: Iran formally announced Strait of Hormuz was closed and threatened to attack any ship attempting to pass. MSC Grace container ship (Liberia) and Safeen Prestige container ship (Malta) attacked. Sonangol Namibe oil tanker (Bahamas) damaged. Shipping insurance rates increased 4-6x.

title: IRGC Sinks UAE Tugboat Mussafah 2 - 4 Crew Killed
description: UAE-flagged tugboat Mussafah 2 sunk by IRGC in the Strait of Hormuz. 4 crew members killed. First vessel completely destroyed in the conflict.

title: Brent Crude Tops $100/Barrel - Largest Oil Price Spike in Decades
description: Brent crude oil prices surpassed $100 per barrel for the first time in four years - the fastest oil price increase during any conflict in recent history. Prices would eventually peak at $126/barrel. Largest disruption to world energy supply since 1970s energy crisis. US national gas price approaching $4/gal.

title: Hezbollah Rockets Strike Central Israel - 18 Wounded, Kindergarten Hit in Ramla
location: Ramla / Beit Shemesh / Elah Valley, Central Israel
description: Hezbollah rocket attacks at central Israel lightly wounded 18 people. A kindergarten in Ramla was directly hit. Smoke seen in Beit Shemesh. Hezbollah stated it targeted a communications site in Elah Valley and a Home Front Command base in Ramla.

title: Mass Tanker Attacks - Mayuree Naree, Safesea Vishnu, Zefyros Struck
location: Strait of Hormuz / Gulf of Oman
description: Multiple ships attacked on same day. Mayuree Naree (Thailand bulk carrier) - aground, 3 crew killed. One Majesty (Japan container ship) - minor damage. Star Gwyneth (Marshall Islands bulk carrier) - damaged. Safesea Vishnu (Marshall Islands oil tanker) - set ablaze, abandoned, 1 crew killed. Zefyros (Malta oil tanker) - set ablaze and abandoned.

title: Hezbollah Fires 200 Rockets at Israel in Single Day
description: Hezbollah fired 200 rockets at Israel in a single day. IDF said 80 failed to enter Israeli territory and it prevented launch of 400 additional rockets. Total Lebanese death toll since escalation: 634 killed, 1,586 wounded.

title: Israeli Strike Kills 12 Medics - Zrarieh Bridge Destroyed
description: Israeli strike on healthcare facility in Burj Qalaouiyah killed 12 medics and injured another. Israel destroyed the Zrarieh Bridge over the Litani River, citing its use in Hezbollah movement. IDF said it killed two senior Hezbollah Badr Unit commanders. Total Lebanese death toll: 773.

title: Hezbollah Cluster Bomb on Metula, Rockets Hit Krayot Area - Highway 4 Closed
description: Hezbollah fired a cluster bomb at Metula. 12 rockets were fired at Upper Galilee. Several rockets hit Krayot area causing damage, prompting closure of Israel's Highway 4.

title: Hezbollah Rockets Hit Nahariya - 6 Injured, Kabri Also Struck
description: Hezbollah rocket attacks injured six people in Nahariya and injured a seventh near Kabri.

title: Hezbollah FPV Drone Strikes IDF Forces at Maroun al-Ras - First FPV Attack
description: Hezbollah launched its first documented FPV explosive drone attack of the war against IDF forces near Maroun al-Ras in south Lebanon. The attack marked the introduction of fiber-optic FPV drones as a primary tactic. Hezbollah published video of the operation. Cost asymmetry: $300-$400 drone vs millions in Israeli equipment.

title: Hezbollah Rocket Barrage Kills Woman, Injures 2 in Northern Israel
description: Hezbollah militants launched a rocket barrage towards northern Israel, killing a woman and injuring two others.

title: Hezbollah Launches 105 Attack Waves on Israel - Most Intense Day of War
description: Hezbollah launched 105 attack waves on Israel on this day - the most intense day of attacks on Israel since the beginning of the 2026 Iran war. Since the war began, 1,084 total attack waves were launched from Lebanon into Israel.

title: Hezbollah Rockets Kill Man, Injure 14 in Nahariya
description: Hezbollah militants launched rockets towards Nahariya, killing a man and injuring 14 others, one seriously.

title: IRGC Expands Strait Ban to US, Israel, and Allies
description: IRGC announced Strait of Hormuz closed to any vessel going to and from ports of US, Israel, and their allies. Trump threatened to destroy Iran infrastructure if strait not reopened. Expressed interest in renaming it.

title: Hezbollah Rocket Halts Israeli Soccer Team Training - Southern Lebanon Fighting
description: An Israeli soccer team had to halt a training session due to the danger posed by a rocket fired from Lebanon. Ongoing fighting in southern Lebanon. An IDF Nahal Brigade soldier was killed in clashes with Hezbollah.

title: IRGC Designates 18 US Tech Companies as Military Targets
description: IRGC designated 18 US technology companies as legitimate military targets, including Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Apple, and Meta. Fortune described this as the first time data centers have been deliberately targeted for air strikes in a conflict. Led to multiple strikes on AWS infrastructure in Bahrain.

title: Temporary Iran-US Ceasefire Agreed - Strait to Reopen
description: Temporary ceasefire between Iran and US agreed. Was to involve reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. Following failure of Islamabad Talks, US Navy began blockade of Iranian ports on April 13, creating dual blockade - US blockading Iran, Iran blockading the Gulf.

title: Operation Eternal Darkness - Israeli Strikes Kill 89 in Lebanon
description: Israel launched Operation Eternal Darkness in Lebanon. Coordinated strikes killed 89 people and wounded 700 across Lebanon. Hezbollah launched 35 waves of attacks on April 2. Total Lebanese death toll since start of war: 1,368. IDF working assumption: fighting with Iran will resume.

title: Hezbollah FPV Drone Hits Israeli Mobile Command Vehicle - Taybeh
description: Hezbollah released FPV drone footage showing an Israeli mobile command vehicle moments before being struck near Taybeh, southern Lebanon. The fiber-optic FPV drone evaded electronic warfare jamming systems. Hezbollah published the complete video of the operation.

title: US Navy Blockades Iranian Ports - Dual Blockade Begins
description: Following failed Islamabad Talks, US Navy began blockading Iranian ports. The Guardian described it as dual blockade - US Navy blockading Iran while Iran blockaded the Gulf. 20,000 mariners and 2,000 ships stranded in Persian Gulf. Brent crude peaked at $126/barrel.

title: Hezbollah FPV Drone Strikes M548 Cargo Carrier at Shomera Artillery Site
description: Hezbollah FPV drone struck an M548 cargo carrier at an IDF artillery site near the northern border community of Shomera. Photographs confirmed the hit. The attack demonstrated Hezbollah ability to penetrate Israeli forward artillery positions with loitering FPV munitions.

title: Hezbollah FPV Drone Kills 4 IDF Soldiers - Dozens Wounded in Campaign
description: Hezbollah FPV drone campaign intensified. Over 80 explosive FPV drones launched at IDF forces in southern Lebanon since March 22. Approximately 15 hit their targets, killing 4 soldiers and 1 civilian, and wounding dozens. IDF scrambling to field countermeasures including fragmenting bullets, Smart Shooter systems, and anti-drone rifles.

title: Operation Project Freedom - US Navy Escorts Merchant Ships
description: Trump launched Operation Project Freedom - a US Navy mission to escort merchant ships out of the Persian Gulf. Iranian military warned this was a ceasefire violation. Paused on May 6 due to great progress toward agreement.

title: Hezbollah Deploys Fiber-Optic FPV Drones - Completely Jam-Proof
description: Hezbollah systematically deployed fiber-optic FPV drones against IDF positions. The optical fiber connects operator to drone with a cable the thickness of dental floss, completely nullifying electronic warfare and spectral jamming. Drone does not emit electromagnetic signal. Detection by electro-optical or acoustic sensors only. Hezbollah has dozens of operators in southern Lebanon.

title: US Naval Blockade of Iran Lifted - Ceasefire Progress
description: US lifted naval blockade of Iranian ports following diplomatic progress toward the Islamabad MOU. Traffic had averaged 6-10 vessels/day during the blockade period. Paved way for the June 17 MOU signing.

title: Hezbollah FPV Drone Operations Expand - Shepherd and Flock Tactic Employed
description: Hezbollah FPV drone tactics evolved to include shepherd and flock model - a central observation drone identifies targets, then directs multiple FPV attack drones. Before launching explosive drone, Hezbollah operatives deploy observation drone to locate and identify target. Launches from inside civilian homes. 5,000 drones seized by Lebanese forces, but thousands more reached Hezbollah.

title: Strike on IRGC Command Center
description: Precision strike on IRGC Quds Force command facility in southern Tehran. Building destroyed. High-value target confirmed eliminated.

title: Islamabad MOU Signed - Trump & Pezeshkian Agree to End War
description: Trump and Iranian President Pezeshkian signed Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding to end the war and blockades of the Strait of Hormuz. Traffic began to normalize. On June 19, Trump announced renewed Israel-Hezbollah ceasefire. However Israel continued strikes in southern Lebanon, and on June 20 Iran closed the strait again.

title: Ballistic Missile Strike on Tel Aviv
description: Iranian Shahab-3 ballistic missile launched from western Iran. Intercepted partially by Iron Dome. Fragment impacts caused casualties.

title: Israel-Hezbollah Ceasefire Agreed - Lasted 24 Hours
description: Trump announced renewed Israel-Hezbollah ceasefire facilitated by US, Qatar, and Iran. However Israel continued strikes in southern Lebanon, and Iran cited this as a violation of the Islamabad MOU, closing the Strait of Hormuz again on June 20. The Israel-Lebanon ceasefire effectively collapsed within 24 hours.

title: US Navy Carrier Group Deployment
description: USS Dwight D. Eisenhower carrier strike group entered the Persian Gulf via the Strait of Hormuz. Iranian IRGC Navy vessels shadowing the group.

title: Iran Re-Closes Strait of Hormuz - Cites Israeli Violations
description: Iran closed the Strait of Hormuz again, citing continued Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon as a violation of the Islamabad MOU agreement. US military denied the claims. Tensions rapidly re-escalated into the July crisis.

title: Drone Strike on Nuclear Facility
description: Multiple UAVs struck the Natanz enrichment facility perimeter. Iran claims air defenses intercepted 3 of 4 drones. Satellite imagery confirms structural damage to centrifuge hall annex.

title: Cyber Attack on Iranian Oil Infrastructure
description: SCADA systems at Kharg Island terminal disrupted. Operations halted for 8 hours. Unconfirmed attribution to US Cyber Command. Iran calling it 'act of war in cyberspace'.

title: Retaliatory Strike on US Base
description: IRGC ballistic missiles targeted Al Asad airbase. US Patriot systems intercepted 7 of 9 missiles. Two impacted within base perimeter. No critical infrastructure hit.

title: US Navy Widens Strait Route Near Oman - Challenges Iran Control
description: Joint Maritime Information Center (JMIC) overseen by US Navy announced widened route through Strait of Hormuz near Oman, allowing increased naval traffic in both directions and challenging Iran control over the waterway.

title: IRGC Speedboat Harassment
description: IRGC Navy fast attack craft approached USNS Supply within 300 meters. Warning shots fired. Vessels withdrew after US helicopter overflight.

title: Strike on IRGC Missile Sites
description: B-2 Spirit stealth bombers struck underground missile storage facilities 40km east of Bushehr. Secondary explosions observed. Satellite imagery shows complete destruction of the site.

title: WSJ: Bahrain & Kuwait Conducted Airstrikes Against Iran — United Arab Front
description: Wall Street Journal reporting Bahrain and Kuwait carried out airstrikes against Iran approximately 2-3 weeks ago. Attacks conducted with Emirati intelligence support and defensive cover, indicating a united Arab front against Iran.

title: IRGC Drone Overflight of US Assets
description: Iranian Mohajer-10 drone approached USS Arleigh Burke within 15 nautical miles. Drone tracked for 45 minutes before returning to Syrian airspace. No engagement.

title: Iran Attacks 3 Ships - US Launches 80+ Strikes on Kharg Island
location: Strait of Hormuz / Kharg Island, Iran
description: Iran attacked 3 commercial vessels in the Strait of Hormuz during Khamenei funeral period. CENTCOM launched 80+ retaliatory strikes hitting Kharg Island (Iran primary oil export hub), Bandar Abbas, Sirik, and Qeshm Island. Brent crude jumped 5.6% to above $78. Iran launched drone attacks on Bahrain Isa Air Base. 2 seafarers killed.

title: Iranian Cyber Attack on US Power Grid
description: Power grid control systems in 3 states experienced unusual network activity. DHS investigating. Iran-linked APT group claimed responsibility but no blackouts occurred.

title: US Strikes Bushehr Nuclear Plant Perimeter - 14 Killed
description: US airstrike hit perimeter of Iran Bushehr nuclear power plant - first time a nuclear facility struck in conflict. 14 killed, 78 wounded. Iran struck Bahrain, Kuwait, Qatar, and Jordan. Jordan intercepted 8 Iranian missiles - first Iranian strike on Jordan. Trump threatened to strike electric and desalination plants.

title: US Strike on IRGC Navy HQ
description: Tomahawk cruise missiles struck IRGC Navy headquarters complex. Intelligence facility and communications array destroyed. Precision strikes with minimal collateral.

title: US Launches 140 Strikes - Largest Package of Conflict
description: CENTCOM launched 140 strikes - largest single strike package of the conflict. Iran struck Jordan Prince Hassan Air Base, UAE, Bahrain, and Qatar. Iran formally declared Strait of Hormuz closed until further notice.

title: Iranian Ballistic Missile Strike on Erbil
description: Multiple Fateh-110 ballistic missiles struck near US consulate facility in Erbil. Missiles intercepted by C-RAM. Debris caused civilian casualties in residential area.

title: Infrastructure War Phase Begins - Bridges & Desalination Struck
description: US strikes destroyed bridges and railway lines near Bandar Abbas, severing main road to strait city. Iran struck Shuaiba power/desalination complex in Kuwait. Bunji desalination plant in Jask destroyed, leaving 20 villages without water. Both sides now deliberately striking civilian infrastructure.

title: Al Dhafra Air Base Completely Empty — US Aircraft Withdrawn
description: Satellite images show that Al Dhafra Air Base in the UAE is now completely empty. Five US aircraft were visible at the base on July 21; recent imagery shows none remaining. Mirrors previous situation at Al Udeid Air Base in Qatar.

title: US Strike on Yazd Military Site
description: US military struck a site in Yazd as part of aerial bombardment campaign across central Iran.

title: Strikes on Multiple Iranian Cities
description: Explosions reported in Ahvaz, Andimeshk, Bandar Abbas, Khorramabad (likely targeting missile city infrastructure), Qeshm island, Jask, and outskirts of Khondab during coordinated US strikes.

title: Strike on IRGC Navy HQ — Zibakenar, Gilan
description: US attacked the IRGC Navy "Hazrat Seyyed al-Shohada" headquarters in Zibakenar, Gilan province — struck with standoff munitions deep in northern Iran near the Caspian Sea.

title: Casualties in Bandar Abbas & Khorramabad Strikes
description: US attacks in Bandar Abbas injured 2 civilians. Attacks in Khorramabad also resulted in 2 civilian injuries. Total Iranian injuries across all strikes reached 645; 55 killed.

title: Iranian Strike on Sheikh Isa Air Base
description: Iranian Army (Artesh) struck fuel storage facilities, large equipment warehouses, hangars, and US army barracks at Sheikh Isa Air Base in Bahrain using Arash drones.

title: Iranian Strike on Muwaffaq al Salti Air Base
location: Muwaffaq al Salti Air Base, Jordan
description: Iranian Army (Artesh) struck aircraft hangars, aircraft maintenance hangars, and barracks at Muwaffaq al Salti Air Base in Jordan.

title: Iranian Strikes on US Bases in Kuwait
location: Camp Buehring, Camp Doha, Camp Arifjan, Kuwait
description: Iranian Army (Artesh) struck US military equipment warehouses at Camp Buehring, a US troop deployment site at Camp Doha, and a US forces deployment site at Camp Arifjan, all in Kuwait.

title: IRGC Drone Strike on Ali Al Salem Air Base
location: Ali Al Salem Air Base, Kuwait
description: IRGC struck a very large ammunition depot at Ali Al Salem Air Base in Kuwait using advanced super-heavy OWA drones. The ammunition depot was completely destroyed. Six large barracks hangars were completely destroyed, three others sustained severe damage. Multiple casualties reported.

title: IRGC Follow-Up Strike on Amazon Data Center
description: IRGC struck the remaining standing building of Amazon's intelligence data center in Bahrain as a follow-up from their previous operation.

title: CENTCOM Naval Blockade — 12 Ships Prevented
description: CENTCOM announced it prevented 12 ships from transiting as part of the ongoing naval blockade and maritime interdiction operations.

title: Iranian Air Defense Interception — Kahnooj
description: Iranian air defenses intercepted an American cruise missile over Kahnooj, Kerman province. Visual proof of the interception was released by Iranian sources.

title: Satellite-Confirmed Strike on Muwaffaq Salti — Radar & Patriot
location: Muwaffaq al Salti Air Base, Jordan
description: Satellite imagery reveals a new attack on Muwaffaq Salti Air Base in Jordan. Iran targeted AN/TPY-2 radar and a Patriot system. Strike hit a newly built area of the base (first seen April 2026).

title: Iranian Missiles & Drones Destroy Sites Near Ahmed Al-Jaber Base
description: Iranian missiles and drones destroyed sites near the Ahmed Al-Jaber Air Base in Kuwait. Strikes took place on July 23, 2026. Video footage from @SimurghRes shows impact and destruction.

title: US Strike on Naeen, Isfahan Province
description: US attacked a site in Naeen, Isfahan province at approximately 3 AM local time.

title: Satellite-Confirmed Strike on US Patriot System — Erbil
description: Satellite imagery confirmed and verified a precise strike on a US Patriot air defense system in Erbil, Iraq. Fires broke out at the targeted site. Imagery shows direct hit on the Patriot battery position.

title: US Strikes on Sirik, Khuzestan & Shahroud
description: American aggression targeted the Sirik area in southern Iran. Explosions also reported in Khuzestan Province and Behbahan in southwestern Iran under US airstrikes. Additional explosions heard in Shahroud, Semnan Province.

title: US Disables Iranian LNG Tanker in Sea of Oman
description: US disabled an Iranian LNG tanker in the Sea of Oman that was attempting to break the blockade on Iranian ports. Two US missiles struck the vessel, martyring 2 crew members and damaging the ship's engine, leaving it disabled.

title: Iranian Retaliation Wave — Bahrain, Kuwait, Erbil
description: Iranian retaliation expanded across Bahrain, Kuwait and Erbil. Explosions in northern Kuwait. Renewed strikes on Kurdish separatist bases in Erbil. Bahrain hit by ballistic missile and drone attacks. Fateh-110 missile directly struck US Fifth Fleet HQ in Juffair. Video footage captured Iranian missile striking target. Smoke columns rising from US base area. Patriot interceptor malfunctioned and fell inside Bahraini territory.

title: Iranian Air Force Fighter Patrols — Iraq Border
description: Iranian Air Force fighter jets conducting patrols near the northern border between Iran and Iraq. US refueling aircraft reported taking off from Ben Gurion heading toward the Persian Gulf.

title: Khatam al Anbiya: One Iranian Killed = One US Servicemember Killed
description: Major General Abdollahi, Commander of Khatam al Anbiya Central Headquarters, declared new operational equation: "For every proud citizen of the Islamic Republic of Iran who is martyred, one American servicemember will be sent to hell. We have prepared free, one-way tickets straight to hell for you." Marks official shift to proportional retaliation doctrine.

title: Two Explosions Reported Near Bushehr
description: Two explosions reported from near Bushehr, Iran. Nature of strikes unclear — potentially targeting IRGC naval or missile facilities in the area.

title: IRIAF F-14 Tomcats Patrol Iran-Iraq Border — MiG-29s Cover Cities
description: Islamic Republic of Iran Air Force F-14 Tomcats conducting patrol operations near the northern Iran-Iraq border. MiG-29s reported covering major cities. US large formation of fighter jets over Jordan simultaneously.

title: Yemeni Missile Severely Damages Saudi Tanker NCC MASA
description: Yemeni armed forces struck oil tanker NCC MASA with a missile in the Red Sea. Vessel sustained severe damage. Tanker had turned off its transponder while sailing from Saudi port of Yanbu toward Bab al-Mandab Strait. Hit before reaching Yemeni coast.

title: Large US Fighter Formation Over Jordan — BACN Aircraft Deploying
description: Large formation of fighter jets over Jordan. E-11 Battlefield Airborne Communications Node (BACN) aircraft out of Prince Sultan Air Base positioning. Likely preparation for strikes on Iran.

title: US P-8 Poseidon Aircraft Active Near Iranian Coasts
description: Several American P-8 Poseidon maritime patrol aircraft now active near the Iranian coasts in the Persian Gulf, conducting surveillance and reconnaissance.

title: US C-17 Transport Aircraft en Route to Ovda Airbase, Israel
description: American C-17 transport aircraft en route to Ovda Airbase in southern Israel. Possible resupply or troop movement related to ongoing operations against Iran.

title: US Refueling Aircraft Deploy from Ben Gurion to Persian Gulf
description: Two American refueling aircraft took off from Ben Gurion Airport heading towards the Persian Gulf. Five refueling aircraft total reported taking off to the east. Indicates preparation for extended air operations.

title: 3 Massive Explosions in Bahrain — Missile Defense Confused
description: 3 massive explosions heard in Bahrain. Iranian drones and ballistic missiles hitting targets in Bahrain. Missile defense interceptors appear confused — low interception rate reported. PAC-3 missile malfunction reported with failed interceptors falling inside Bahraini territory.

title: Trump Refuses to Rule Out Bombing Civilian Infrastructure in Iran
description: Trump refused to answer when asked if bombing civilian power plants and bridges in Iran constituted a war crime. Removed from press conference when pressed by NYT reporter. The Guardian also reported Trump switched planes in Turkey due to Iran proxy threat to target Air Force One.

title: Iraqi Military Deploys Against Resistance Factions — US Pressure Mounts
description: Heavy Iraqi military deployments in Baghdad and Baqubah. Forces attempted to storm Nujaba Movement headquarters in Jurf al-Nadaf. PMF leadership ordered withdrawal after warning shots. Trump administration pressuring Iraqi Kurdistan to join war against Iran or lose autonomous status.

title: Saudi Airstrikes on Hodeidah Port & Kamaran Island — Retaliation
description: Saudi Arabia launched widespread airstrikes across Hodeidah Governorate in retaliation for the NCC MASA tanker strike. Fuel storage tanks at Hodeidah Port and eastern Hodeidah targeted. Kamaran Island also struck. A communications facility worker and a woman on Kamaran Island were injured. At least four airstrikes on the port. Yemeni air defenses forced several Saudi fighter jets to withdraw from Yemeni airspace.

title: Yemeni Ballistic Missile Launches Toward Saudi Arabia
description: Reports of missile launches from Yemen towards Saudi Arabia. Rasd Akhbar Shehaba: "The Yemeni response enters into force." Part of broader Ansar Allah retaliation campaign.

title: Yemen Drones Strike Abha Airport & Jazan Port, Saudi Arabia
description: Yemeni forces launched drones targeting Abha International Airport and Jazan Port in Saudi Arabia. Part of expanded Ansar Allah retaliation operations.

title: 5 Ballistic Missiles Target ARAMCO Terminal at Jazan Port
description: At least 5 ballistic missiles targeted the ARAMCO oil terminal at Jazan Port, Saudi Arabia. Significant escalation in Yemeni attacks on Saudi energy infrastructure.

title: Ballistic Missile & Drone Attack on Bahrain — At Least One Impact
description: Ballistic missile and drone attack on Bahrain with at least one confirmed impact. Multiple explosions reported across the country.

title: Israeli Bombing Targets al-Masha and Hadatha in Southern Lebanon
description: Three Israeli bombings at different times targeted the al-Masha neighborhood in al-Mansouri, southern Lebanon. Violent bombing also targeted the town of Hadatha. Part of ongoing Israeli operations against Hezbollah positions along the border.

title: Operation Nasr 2: IRGC 27th Wave Hits Al-Udeid Ammo Depots & Fifth Fleet Watchtower
location: Al-Udeid Air Base, Qatar / Fifth Fleet HQ, Bahrain
description: IRGC 27th wave of Operation Nasr 2 under code phrase 'O Aba Saleh Al-Mahdi, come to my aid'. Targeted three ammunition and equipment storage depots at Al-Udeid base in Qatar, setting them ablaze and destroying them. Simultaneously targeted the watchtower of the US Fifth Fleet in Bahrain, inflicting significant damage.

title: Operation Saeqah Phase 25: Iran Army Strikes Al-Udeid, Camp Doha, Camp Arifjan
description: Iranian Army (Artesh) 25th phase of Operation Saeqah. Targeted equipment storage facilities at Al-Udeid Base (Qatar), US troop deployment site at Camp Doha (Kuwait), and US forces deployment at Camp Arifjan (Kuwait) using Arash suicide drones. Series of intensive drone and missile operations continuing.

title: IRGC Claims THAAD Radar, Patriot & C-RAM Destroyed at US Base
description: IRGC claimed destruction of a THAAD missile defense system radar. Patriot air defense system and C-RAM radar also targeted and destroyed. Fuel storage tanks at the US base set ablaze. Large helicopter equipment warehouse and maintenance hangar also set on fire and destroyed.

title: Mass Shelter Openings Across Israel - Iranian Missile Threat Escalates
location: Tel Aviv, Ramat Gan, Haifa, Be'er Sheva, Ashkelon, Nahariya, Safed, Acre, Karmiel + more
description: Multiple Israeli cities announced opening of public shelters due to escalating Iranian missile threat: Tel Aviv-Yafo, Ramat Gan, Haifa, Be'er Sheva, Ashkelon, Nesher, Karmiel, Kiryat Tivon, Tirat Carmel, Modi'in, Kiryat Gat, Migdal HaEmek, Ma'alot-Tarshiha, Acre, Nahariya, Safed. Mayor of Ramat Gan: 'The threat of Iranian missile launches has increased over the coming weekend.' Israel Hayom assessment: US will strike, Iran will target Gulf bases but not Israel directly to avoid giving Netanyahu pretext to join campaign.

title: Yemen Ballistic Missiles Strike King Khalid Airbase, Khamis Mushait
description: Yemeni forces launched ballistic missiles targeting King Khalid Airbase in Khamis Mushait, Saudi Arabia. Part of ongoing retaliatory operations following Saudi airstrikes on Hodeidah port.

title: Yemen Missile & Drone Attack Hits Yanbu, Dhahran, Jizan - Saudi Air Defense Failures Reported
description: Yemen launched combined missile and drone attack on Saudi Arabia after Saudi strikes on Hodeidah. More than 5 explosions in Jizan, industrial area targeted. Powerful explosions in Yanbu port city and Dhahran. Explosions reported in Samad/Zamd. Saudi authorities called for restrictions on publishing footage showing casualties and explosion scenes - indicating significant air defense failures. 5+ ballistic missiles targeted ARAMCO facilities in Jizan area. Geolocation analysis suggests impacts near Jizan ARAMCO refinery.

title: Austrian Airlines & ITA Airways Cancel Flights to Israel Amid Escalation Fears
description: Austrian Airlines and ITA Airways canceled their morning flights to Israel amid fears of an escalation with Iran. Israel N12 news reporting. Multiple Israeli cities opened public shelters simultaneously.

title: Saudi Airstrike on Hodeidah Port - 1 Injured, Yemen Vows Violent Response
description: Saudi Arabia launched airstrike on Hodeidah port, Yemen. 1 person injured. Yemen Ansarallah vowed a violent response and launched retaliatory missile and drone attacks on Saudi cities including Jizan, Yanbu, and Dhahran. Yemeni Foreign Ministry: the equation of escalation for escalation is now the defining feature.
